title: Share cached catalog requests
description: A cache simplification changes request identity and the objects returned to offer builders.
commitMessage: Reuse catalog promises and add display labels to offers.
reviewContext: Each tenant has an independent price catalog, including overlapping SKUs. Tenant and SKU identifiers are nonempty and contain no colon. A cache instance serves several tenants for its whole lifetime. Failed loads must be retried by a later get call; concurrent reads of one tenant/SKU may share an in-flight request. Product contains only the flat fields shown and source.load returns validated data. Every caller must receive its own mutable Product copy; offer deliberately adjusts that copy. Discounts are already validated between zero and the base price. No expiry policy or concurrent invalidation is required in this exercise.
